stop_if: A design is edited to satisfy the test; the test exists to find a contradiction, not to be satisfied.

declared_non_coverage: Only back-references are held. A design may still contradict itself in a way no mechanical rule sees, and the reading of 2026-09-06 does not rerun.
Numerals, ranges and counts spelled across a sentence are not read.
Nothing here checks whether any count is correct, only whether one design counts one set two ways.
A noun of more than one word is read as its first word only, so 'these two service accounts' is held on 'service'.
